# Hardware Modules

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-catalog-docs.py. Edit lib/catalog-docs.nix instead. -->

Hardware modules describe physical machine support. Most hosts should choose one CPU module and one graphics module.

## cpuAmd

Layer: `hardware`

Enables AMD CPU microcode updates.

Guidance: Use on hosts with an AMD CPU.

## cpuIntel

Layer: `hardware`

Enables Intel CPU microcode updates.

Guidance: Use on hosts with an Intel CPU.

## graphicsAmd

Layer: `hardware`

Enables AMDGPU, OpenGL, 32-bit graphics support, VA-API tooling, and Vulkan tooling.

Guidance: Use on hosts whose primary GPU is AMD.

## graphicsIntel

Layer: `hardware`

Enables Intel integrated or Arc graphics through the modesetting driver, OpenGL, 32-bit graphics support, VA-API tooling, Vulkan tooling, and Intel GPU diagnostics.

Guidance: Use on hosts whose primary GPU is Intel integrated graphics or Intel Arc.

## graphicsNvidia

Layer: `hardware`

Enables the NVIDIA driver, graphics support, NVIDIA settings, and Wayland-oriented NVIDIA session variables.

Guidance: Use on hosts whose primary GPU is NVIDIA.

## tpmLuks

Layer: `hardware`

Configures TPM2 support for unlocking a LUKS root device labeled `cryptroot`.

Guidance: Use after the target host is intentionally installed with this disk layout.
